evidence: COPY MCPAREA / ORCA-SPA / LINKAREA pattern typical of JMA ORCA
EXEC SQL absent, MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT window management pattern

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (resepto) software - reception/patient registration list screen (受付一覧 U01)
purpose.summary: This program implements the patient reception list screen (U01) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It manages display and navigation of a list of up to 400 registered patients per page, handling screen initialization, entry, and screen transitions via MCP window management calls. It reads patient master, reception, insurance combination, and system management data to populate the list.

notable_features: MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT window management (ORCA-specific middleware, not CICS)
30 COPY statements for copybooks (CPUKETUKE.INC, CPPTINF.INC, CPHKNCOMBI.INC, etc.)
OCCURS 400 table for patient list with dual-page buffering (OCCURS 2)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments throughout (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage; no EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
REDEFINES usage for age display formatting
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, appearing as mojibake. This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical system (JMA ORCA). The program is a subprogram called by the ORCA MCP middleware framework, functioning similarly to an online transaction program. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 87736 bytes total.
